name: Polyculturalism
summary: Polyculturalism holds that cultures have always been interwoven, impure and in motion, so people's identities draw on many traditions rather than one bounded heritage. Coined by Robin D. G. Kelley and developed by Vijay Prashad, it contrasts itself with multiculturalism (which it sees as treating cultures as fixed, separate units) and with colour blindness, and it treats race as a social construct while taking racism and power seriously. It is an account of culture and identity, so it says little on economics or institutions.
scope: The radical-left, Afro-Asian strand: Kelley's 1999 essay 'The People in Me' (ColorLines), Prashad's 'Everybody Was Kung Fu Fighting' (2001), and the Wikipedia account that also cites Jacob Dorman. Answers on economic and institutional questions are low-confidence inferences from the left politics of Kelley and Prashad, since the concept itself is a theory of culture and identity. The social-psychology research use of the term (Rosenthal and Levy) is not covered.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Not addressed by the cultural theory itself; inferred from the egalitarian, Marxist-leaning politics of Prashad and Kelley.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's focus on the Black working class and racial capitalism; the concept itself is silent on wage policy.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's recurrent criticism of capitalism; polyculturalism proper takes no stand on market efficiency.

public-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the socialist leanings of its main theorists, not from anything in the polyculturalist texts.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Inferred from the left, anti-capitalist politics of Kelley and Prashad; no source ties it to polyculturalism directly.

unions-good.rationale: Kelley's work centres on the Black working class and radical movements, so union support is a likely but inferred position.

property-fundamental.rationale: Inferred from the theorists' critique of capitalism; the cultural concept does not address property rights.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's critiques of capitalism and imperialism; not stated as part of polyculturalism.

cut-welfare.rationale: Inferred from the pro-emancipation, working-class orientation of Kelley; welfare cuts are not discussed in the concept.

worker-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the Marxist and socialist commitments of Prashad; adherents of the cultural concept may not share them.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's focus on state repression of radical movements; the concept itself says nothing on surveillance.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Inferred from a general anti-carceral left outlook; not addressed in the polyculturalist texts.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Adherents oppose racism but the sources never address legal speech limits, so this is genuinely open.

strong-leader.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on radical grassroots movements and emancipation; leader-centred rule is not discussed.

state-harmful.rationale: Kelley stresses liberation, not abolition of the state; Prashad is a Marxist who accepts state projects, so a mild disagreement is inferred.

limit-guns.rationale: The concept does not address firearms and left adherents are split on armed self-defence traditions in Black radical politics.

empower-police-military.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's attention to racialized policing in radical Black politics; not part of the concept proper.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Not addressed by the sources and left adherents are split on it.

decide-locally.rationale: Not addressed; polyculturalism stresses transnational exchange but takes no stance on the level of government.

rehabilitation.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's critical stance on the criminal justice system and focus on structural causes.

traditional-family.rationale: Kelley's own essay treats families as mixed and boundary-crossing and rejects purity narratives, which suggests scepticism of a single traditional ideal.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Inferred from the theorists' left-liberationist politics; Kelley describes himself as a Marxist surrealist feminist.

abortion-legal.rationale: Inferred from the feminist and emancipatory politics Kelley identifies with; not discussed in the concept itself.

more-religion-public.rationale: Kelley notes religions blend across cultures but takes no stand on public religion; mild disagreement inferred from secular-left leanings.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Prashad criticises colour blindness as shortsighted because it ignores systemic advantages and supports measures like affirmative action, while Kelley says multiculturalism obscures power relations.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Race is treated as a social construct in the concept; applying the same logic to gender is inferred from Kelley's feminism.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The concept sees cultures as fluid and impure, so a fixed national culture to be preserved is contrary to its core claim; the sources do not discuss nations directly.

gradual-change.rationale: Inferred from the radical emancipatory politics of its theorists; not addressed by the concept.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Cultural mixing is treated as the normal condition and ethno-nationalism as a barrier to overcome, so restricting immigration runs against it, though immigration policy is not directly discussed.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Prashad is a critic of Western-dominated bodies yet favours Global South solidarity, so adherents would be split.

free-trade.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's criticism of capitalism and neocolonialism; trade policy is not part of the concept.

nation-first.rationale: Kelley reads movements as products of global dialogue and criticises purity narratives, so putting one nation ahead of cooperation contradicts the outlook.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Prashad opposed the NATO intervention in Libya as usurped, suggesting scepticism, but the cultural concept is silent.

open-borders.rationale: Follows loosely from the idea that boundaries between peoples are blurred and ethno-nationalism is a barrier; no source states an open-borders programme.

limit-growth.rationale: Not addressed and left adherents split between degrowth and Global South development priorities.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Inferred from the left politics of its theorists; not part of the concept.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Inferred from critiques of capitalism and imperialism; the concept does not address technology.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Not addressed; no clear position among left adherents.

revolution-justified.rationale: Prashad supports communism and Kelley writes on radical movements, but polyculturalism proper is not about revolution.

experts-over-public.rationale: Inferred from a grassroots, movement-centred outlook; not discussed.

central-planning.rationale: Prashad is sympathetic to socialist states but the concept does not address planning, and adherents differ.

socialized-markets.rationale: Not addressed; adherents with socialist views could go either way on market socialism.

land-value-tax.rationale: Not an issue the sources touch; no basis for a lean.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from egalitarian, anti-capitalist politics, not stated in the sources.

basic-income.rationale: Inferred from the left egalitarian politics of the theorists; not discussed.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Prashad backs Global South economic sovereignty but also opposes nationalism, so no clear lean.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Not addressed; socialist-leaning adherents might approve, others distrust state direction.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Not addressed; neither the concept nor its authors take a position on small property versus collective ownership.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Marxist adherents may endorse it as a long-term goal, but the concept does not address it.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Inferred from anti-capitalist politics; leaving money to the market would be rejected, though the issue is not discussed.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Not addressed; a movement-based, grassroots outlook makes state-run corporatist bodies unlikely.

one-party-rule.rationale: Not addressed; Kelley's emphasis on emancipation and grassroots radicalism implies opposition.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Inferred from the rejection of hierarchy and purity; not discussed.

democracy-best.rationale: Inferred from pro-emancipation politics; the sources do not address regime types.

direct-votes.rationale: Referendum-style lawmaking is never discussed by the theorists, so adherents have no shared position.

workers-councils.rationale: Marxist adherents may like it but the concept does not address the form of political power.

right-to-secede.rationale: Not addressed; solidarity across groups pulls against separatism while anti-colonial politics supports self-determination.

natural-rulers.rationale: The concept treats race as a social construct and cultures as unhierarchical, so inherent fitness to rule is incompatible with it.

political-violence-never.rationale: Radical-left adherents typically allow violence in liberation struggles, though the concept is silent.

war-builds-character.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's anti-imperialism and anti-militarism; not addressed in the concept.

separate-church-state.rationale: The sources describe religious blending but never address church-state law, so no lean is justified.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Inferred from the stress on fluid, hybrid cultures and secular-left politics; not discussed.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Inferred from socialist, anti-capitalist politics; not addressed.

military-superiority.rationale: Prashad's anti-imperialist writing implies opposition to pursuing military dominance, though it is inferred.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The Wikipedia account says ethno-nationalism is a barrier to be overcome in building a dynamic community culture, directly opposing a nation of one ethnic group.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Inferred from the Marxist leanings of Prashad and Kelley; not stated in the concept.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Inferred from the left politics of the theorists; not discussed.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Inferred from anti-colonial radical politics; the sources do not discuss it.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Prashad's anti-colonial work makes reparations plausible, but no source states it for polyculturalism.

civilizational-union.rationale: Kelley rejects bounded cultural blocs, so uniting by a single civilization contradicts the framework, but it is not directly discussed.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Socialist leanings of the main theorists suggest scepticism of self-interest as a moral ideal; inferred.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Inferred from emancipatory politics; not addressed.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Environmental ethics lie outside the cultural concept and its sources.

limit-population.rationale: Inferred from left Global South politics that oppose population control; not discussed.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Not addressed; Marxist leanings favour development over rejection of industry.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Not addressed; inferred scepticism from critiques of capitalism.

human-enhancement.rationale: Bodily technology is outside the sources; adherents have no shared view.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Not addressed; mild scepticism inferred from grassroots emphasis.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from attention to state repression of radicals.

restore-past-order.rationale: Kelley calls for taking history more seriously and treats pure pasts as myths, and Prashad names the idea of cultural purity a myth.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Not addressed; Marxist-leaning theorists are ideologically committed but this is not part of the concept.

direct-action.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's focus on radical movements; not stated.

means-match-ends.rationale: Prefigurative politics is not discussed by Kelley or Prashad in the sources read.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Inferred; no connection to the concept and contrary to historical Marxist leanings.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Marxist adherents may endorse it as an ultimate goal; not addressed in the concept.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Inferred from communist sympathies of Prashad; not part of the concept.

production-for-use.rationale: Inferred from socialist and anti-capitalist politics.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Kelley uses racial capitalism and works from a Marxist tradition, so this is likely but inferred.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Communist adherents may endorse; the concept is silent and Kelley is not doctrinaire.

collective-farming.rationale: Agrarian organisation is not addressed by the concept; communists among adherents could differ.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Prashad criticises capitalism and imperialism recurrently, but the link to great-power war is not stated.

taxation-theft.rationale: A left-leaning movement would reject this libertarian claim, though no source addresses taxation.

harm-principle.rationale: Neither the concept nor its authors discuss the limits of state power over private conduct.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Kelley's critique of multiculturalism concerns group boundaries rather than rights; mild disagreement inferred from collective struggle focus.

conscription.rationale: Opposition is inferred from the anti-militarist side of Prashad's anti-imperialism.

state-as-business.rationale: Treating citizens as customers contradicts the anti-capitalist politics of the theorists; inferred.

positive-liberty.rationale: Kelley's emancipatory politics stresses liberation as a positive goal; not directly stated for material means.

media-academia-power.rationale: Not addressed; left adherents usually see capital and states as more powerful.

hereditarian-race.rationale: The Wikipedia article states polyculturalism treats race as a social construct with no scientific basis, which excludes a genetic account of group differences.

organic-representation.rationale: Corporatist or communal representation is outside the sources.

total-state.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on fluid, bottom-up cultural exchange; not addressed.

national-rebirth.rationale: The concept treats ethno-nationalism as a barrier and national cultures as mixed, rejecting rebirth myths of purity.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Prashad's anti-imperialism implies rejection; inferred rather than stated.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Feudal-style authority is never addressed by the concept or its theorists.

bound-labor.rationale: Inferred from emancipatory politics focused on liberation from servitude.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Kelley argues Europeans deny African contributions to Western civilization, hinting that knowledge reflects power, but the claim is not stated in general form.

universal-morality.rationale: Not addressed; scepticism of purity narratives pulls one way, anti-racist universals the other.

single-common-good.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from emphasis on power relations and conflicting interests.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Prashad sits on a boycott campaign advisory board, but polyculturalism itself does not address it.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Not addressed; Kelley treats diaspora as mixed rather than defined by return.

revive-national-language.rationale: Inferred from hostility to purity narratives; not discussed.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Inferred from the socialist leanings of Prashad; the concept itself does not cover firms.

school-vouchers.rationale: Education finance is not discussed; inferred opposition from left politics.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Austerity-minded fiscal rules conflict with left economic politics, but the sources are silent.

economic-freedom.rationale: The claim that liberty needs capitalism conflicts with Prashad's critique of capitalism; inferred.

rule-by-example.rationale: Moral government by rulers' example is never discussed in the sources.

national-self-determination.rationale: Anti-colonial politics supports self-determination, but the concept distrusts ethnic nation-states, so adherents split.

force-without-un.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's opposition to Western interventions.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Kelley treats religious and cultural traditions as living, but the sources do not rank reason over faith.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The concept rejects dividing people into bounded groups and treats ethno-nationalism as a barrier, so excluding immigrants from welfare opposes it; welfare itself is not discussed.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Workfare conditions conflict with egalitarian left politics; inferred, not stated.

class-collaboration.rationale: Marxist-influenced theorists treat class conflict as real, so partnership between classes is doubted; inferred.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Kelley insists on taking history seriously, but polyculturalism also rejects fixed heritage; not addressed directly.

dominated-front.rationale: Prashad shows Black leaders like Garvey and Malcolm X tied Black fates to non-white peoples worldwide, supporting cross-national solidarity of subordinated peoples.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Kelley's feminist self-description implies rejection of legally distinct roles; inferred.

ban-interest.rationale: Neither the cultural concept nor its theorists take up usury law, and left adherents would split.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Prashad builds polyculturalism against the idea of separate pure groups; legal segregation is its opposite, though the sources do not discuss segregation law.

state-class-instrument.rationale: A Marxist account of the state fits Prashad but is not part of polyculturalism proper.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Left politics usually opposes this, but the sources do not discuss energy.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Wikipedia says polyculturalism views cultures as interactive and individuals as free to add or drop elements, and aims at a new common identity through mutual blending rather than one group giving up its culture.

elite-replacement.rationale: Rests on a view of fixed native populations whose mixing is a threat, the opposite of polyculturalism's premise; the conspiracy claim itself is not discussed.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral systems are not discussed by the theorists.

national-mission.rationale: Prashad's anti-imperialism implies rejecting a mission to export a state form; inferred.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's self-description as feminist.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Left critics often say so, but the sources make no claim about political elites.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Inferred from anti-racist, emancipatory politics; eugenics is not discussed.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's work on state repression.

night-watchman-state.rationale: A minimal state conflicts with the left politics of the theorists; inferred.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Kelley's essay describes everyone as having mixed pasts, which leaves no basis for discouraging mixed families; it is descriptive rather than a stated policy position.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Cultures are described as unhierarchical and race as a social construct, which implies equal standing of all people, though the sources do not phrase it as a rights claim.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Debates on Soviet strategy are outside the concept and its sources.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Not addressed; adherents may split between common law and recognising communities.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Inferred from the view that people may add or drop cultural elements, including religions such as Kelley's examples of Eastern religion in the Nation of Islam.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Religiously motivated food laws are not covered by the sources.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Religious instruction in schools is not addressed, and adherents have no common line.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Marxist-Leninist state theory is not part of polyculturalism.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Pro-emancipation politics suggests support, though the sources do not discuss legitimacy.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilist trade aims are not discussed in the sources.

population-transfer.rationale: Treating minorities as removable contradicts the idea that groups are intertwined and the opposition to ethno-nationalism.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Not addressed; radical-left adherents usually reject absolute pacifism or libertarian rules.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Prashad rejects fear-driven views of culture based on survival and contamination, and describes exchange as natural; struggle between peoples as the engine of progress contradicts this.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Militant democracy is never discussed by the theorists.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Inferred from emancipatory politics; not explicit.

separated-powers.rationale: Constitutional design is not covered by the concept.

vanguard-party.rationale: Marxist adherents are split; the concept does not address it.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's focus on the Black working class.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: British housing policy is outside the sources and adherents have no shared position.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Opposition is inferred from Kelley's focus on working-class struggle.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's structural, anti-colonial analysis of poverty.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Wikipedia reports supporters argue that blending and interconnection build social cohesion, and that it is multiculturalism's emphasis on difference that divides, so diversity itself is not seen as a source of conflict.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Sortition is not discussed by the theorists.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Opposition is inferred from Kelley's attention to state repression of radical movements.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Left economic politics make support likely, but the sources do not discuss price policy.

party-controls-media.rationale: Media control by a ruling party is not addressed by the sources.

party-commands-army.rationale: Party-army relations are a Leninist question the sources never raise.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Inferred from opposition to ethno-nationalism and gatekeeping; not discussed.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Politician pay is not addressed in the sources.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party discipline is not addressed in the sources.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Not addressed; transnational orientation helps but Prashad is critical of Western blocs.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Executive structure is outside the concept.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is outside the concept and the sources.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Not addressed; Marxist internationalists may agree.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Kelley celebrates cultural creativity such as jazz and hip-hop; censorship is contrary though not discussed.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Term rules are not addressed in the sources.

recall-officials.rationale: Not addressed; mild lean from grassroots democratic emphasis.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Prashad is critical of NATO but the concept does not address alliances.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Housing tenure is not discussed in the sources.

people-in-arms.rationale: Militia versus standing army is not addressed in the sources.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Not addressed; Kelley's examples are largely urban cultural mixing.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: National reunification is not addressed in the sources.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: The theorists are academics and the sources make no claim about the educated.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Kelley describes cultures as living and interacting and rejects fixed ranked entities; Dorman's formulation in Wikipedia calls cultures unhierarchical, so no culture is higher or lower.

death-penalty.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's critique of racialized criminal justice.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Support is inferred from the feminist and liberationist politics of Kelley.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: The sources do not address school science curricula.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Adherents differ on this, and the sources do not discuss it.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Kelley argues identity cannot be explained by biological descent, which undercuts citizenship by descent; no source discusses nationality law.

minority-language-support.rationale: Cultural interaction is welcomed, so language support is plausible, though the concept prefers blending to preserving separate groups.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Multiculturalism favours group protections while polyculturalism is less rigid on group identity, so adherents are split.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Wikipedia says individuals shape their own identities and may add or drop cultural elements, which fits encouraging nonconformity.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Inferred from Prashad's critique of neocolonialism.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's pro-emancipation, democratic-radical outlook; constitution-making is not discussed.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Authoritarian development is opposed by Kelley's pro-emancipation politics; inferred.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Support is inferred from Prashad's Global South solidarity, though he is also critical of aid as charity.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Opposition is inferred from anti-militarism and Prashad's critique of Western powers.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Executive selection is not addressed by the sources.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Insulating money from elected governments conflicts with left economic politics; inferred.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Insisting on historic territorial claims conflicts with the concept's distrust of nationalism; inferred.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Socialist leanings of Prashad suggest agreement, but it is inferred.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Not addressed; Marxists disagree among themselves.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environmental policy is not discussed; left politics suggests support.

collective-defense.rationale: Alliance obligations are not addressed by the sources.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Church-state relations are not addressed by the sources.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Ceremonial head-of-state roles are not addressed by the sources.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Special-autonomy arrangements are not addressed by the sources.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Divine kingship conflicts with the anti-hierarchical, egalitarian orientation; inferred.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Regressive-leaning tax design conflicts with egalitarian left politics; inferred.

character-from-environment.rationale: Polyculturalism sees identities as shaped by cultural contact and individuals as making their own, which stresses circumstances over innate nature, though this is not stated in these terms.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Unbound rulers conflict with emancipatory politics; inferred.

space-expansion.rationale: Space policy is not addressed by the sources.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical constitutional theory is not addressed by the sources.

leader-cult.rationale: Personality cults conflict with the grassroots emphasis of Kelley's radical-movement scholarship; inferred.

informal-organisation.rationale: Organising form is not addressed by the sources.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Prashad's rejection of origins and authenticity undermines claims based on ancestral priority, but land disputes are not discussed.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Opposition is inferred from liberationist politics.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Support is inferred from Marxist leanings.

ban-fgm.rationale: Not addressed; adherents may treat it as a human-rights or cultural question.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Left self-determination politics suggests support for local voice, though the theory itself is silent; inferred.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Prashad's anti-imperialism treats colonial borders as arbitrary impositions, though the theory does not address the question; inferred.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the Marxist-leaning left politics of Prashad and Kelley, which favour common claims on shared resources.

self-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the left-libertarian strain in its anti-authoritarian, anti-racist politics; the sources do not discuss it.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Inferred from left politics, which sees consumption taxes as regressive; not addressed by the cultural theory.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Inferred from egalitarian left politics that usually favours universal provision over means-tested help; not addressed in the sources.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Inferred from its radical-left, grassroots and movement-based politics, which values organised groups rather than bypassing them.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Inferred from left critiques of corporate power and cronyism; not addressed by the cultural theory.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Inferred from its opposition to ethnic and religious separation of communities and its stress on mixing across groups.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: Inferred from its rejection of cultural purity and fixed heritage, which opposes a return to one people's ancestral values.

wife-divorce-without-consent.rationale: Inferred from the feminist and egalitarian commitments of its left proponents.

national-resource-control.rationale: Inferred from anti-imperialist left politics that favours public control of resources over foreign corporations.

distribution-by-process.rationale: Inferred from Kelley's focus on racial capitalism and Prashad's Marxism, which judge wealth by historic injustice and outcomes.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Not addressed by the cultural theory; inferred from Prashad's anti-imperialist, anti-capitalist politics.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Polyculturalism contrasts itself with colour blindness and takes racism and power seriously.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: Kelley's attention to radical movements suggests unjust laws are resisted, but the concept does not address natural law; inferred.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Not addressed by the theory; inferred from Kelley's and Prashad's left politics.

multipolar-world.rationale: Not addressed by the theory; inferred from Prashad's anti-imperialist, Non-Aligned-leaning politics.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Not stated in the concept; inferred from the Marxist views of Prashad and Kelley.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Not addressed; Prashad's Marxism is anti-capitalist yet the concept says nothing on this question.

missingStatements.text: People's identities should be understood as drawing on many cultures rather than belonging to one group.
missingStatements.rationale: Kelley argues all people inherit European, African, Native American and Asian pasts and that polyculturalism means expanding who counts as Black.

notes: Polyculturalism is a theory of culture and identity rather than a full programme, so most economic and institutional answers are inferences from the left politics of Kelley and Prashad and are marked low confidence. Other uses of the term, such as psychological measures of belief in cultural interconnection, are not covered.
